items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: I knew the Majotas lived right around the corner from me.

ctx.x: What about before him? Would there be any good ones before him?
Well, Tony Majada played fairly good trumpet. He played pretty good trumpet. Dan Hughes played pretty good trumpet. Pete Dickens played pretty good trumpet.
And you played with, what do you call him? Borgie Shalane? Well, he was a drummer.
